pr_title: TSDB: Simplify OOO Select by copying the head chunk
pr_body:
Instead of carrying around extra fields in `Meta` structs which let us approximate what was in the chunk at the time, take a copy of the chunk.

This simplifies lots of code, and lets us correct a couple of tests which were embedding the wrong answer.

Fixes #11837

issue_context.title: Simplify `chunks.Meta` by removing the OOO fields
issue_context.body:
### Proposal

With OOO support, we introduced 3 new fields to the chunk meta:
https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/f88a0a7d83bb9ef4387ff158d43f5a0c580fffdf/tsdb/chunks/chunks.go#L125-L132

This unnecessarily bloats the chunk meta because these fields are only required by the Head block's OOO Head reader (the part that reads the OOO data from the Head), and are not required everywhere else. We can likely find a way that does not require these fields to be inside the meta. For example, store that information with the Head block's OOO reader wrapper.

How to do this is still TBD. Ideas are welcome :)

---

This issue is broken down from https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/11329
comments: I want to work on this issue. Can you please assign it to me?

Could you please give more clarification on the example solution you've mentioned?

Alternate solution:
After going through the code, for a `Series()` call we are storing the same markers data for the overlapping chunks.
As these markers is mainly used in `oooMergedChunk` method, we can move it to `memSeriesOOOFields` struct.

Please do let me know your thoughts on this.

review_comments: Removing this without any replacement introduced a bug. The symptom is worst in compaction, where it can fail seeing overlapping chunks.
This avoids crashing on a nil pointer, but is still unrealistic since an OOO chunk with zero samples should not be created in the real code.
This could be `ToXORBetweenTimestamps(oh.mint, oh.maxt)`, but I'll leave that change for a later PR.
